t: This LAP modular coaxial TV socket offers a flexible solution for electrical installations. It features a female IEC socket and is designed for seamless integration into a modular grid system. Ideal for electricians and AV installers creating custom wall plates in residential or commercial properties, this unscreened TV socket ensures reliable signal connection. Features a gloss white finish and screw terminals for straightforward wiring. A minimum back box depth of 25mm is required for installation.
